lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Zr2Cu2Bi2 (reduced formula ZrCuBi) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with six atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi centers with 10 neighbors (2 Bi, 4 Cu, 4 Zr), Cu centers with 11 neighbors (2 Bi, 2 Cu, 7 Zr), and Zr centers with 12 neighbors (4 Bi, 6 Cu, 2 Zr), forming a single three-dimensional periodic component. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts reveal corner, edge, and face sharing among the 10-vertex Bi polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Cu and Zr polyhedra, though these relations are not exclusive to all polyhedra.
